data.title: Apollo 12 and Surveyor 3
data.credit: Apollo 12, Alan Bean - Stereo Image Copyright: Kevin Frank
data.alt: Astronaut standing next to Surveyor 3 on the Moon.

data.title: NGC 206 and the Star Clouds of Andromeda
data.alt: Close up of NGC 206 in the Andromeda galaxy.

data.title: Moon, Venus and Spica Meet
data.alt: A crescent moon and bright Venus appear beyond a mountain in a rural area at dusk.

data.title: NGC 4449: Small Galaxy, Big Impact
data.credit: NASA, ESA, A. Aloisi (STScI/ESA), and the Hubble Heritage (STScI/AURA)-ESA/Hubble Collaboration
data.alt: A large smear of stars, almost shaped like a bow-tie, covers most of the image. The center of the "bow" is full of pink clumps of gas, while the outsides consist of blue-white stars, streaks of dark dust, and more pink globs of gas.

data.title: Saturn Behind the Moon
data.alt: The curving surface of the Moon occupies the lower half of the image. Just above center the planet Saturn appears, far in the distance.

data.title: Rigel and the Witch Head Nebula
data.alt: A starfield filled with red glowing gas is seen surroinging a bright blue star near the center. To the upper right of the star is an unusually shaped blue-tinted nebula.

data.title: Major Fireball Meteor
data.alt: A mountainous landscape with snow and trees is seen below a starry sky. A pink band is visible on the horizon. Coming down from the sky is a bright meteor trail. Just above the meteor are the stars of the Big Dipper. Please see the explanation for more detailed information.
